ex.t: 他们还有一个小池塘，他们在里面养鱼。

ex.s: In 1845, he began his famous two-year stay at Walden Pond, which he wrote about in his masterwork, Walden.
ex.t: 1845年，他开始了在瓦尔登湖畔那段著名的两年生活，他在其杰作《瓦尔登湖》中写到了这段经历。

ex.s: For two years, two months and two days, he lived in a cottage in the forest on the edge of Walden Pond, focusing on himself and his writing.
ex.t: 两年两个月零两天里，他住在瓦尔登湖边森林中的一座小屋里，专注于自己和写作。

ex.s: He explained his reason for doing so in Walden: “I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front essential facts of life ” Background information Walden Pond is a lake in Concord, Massachusetts, in the United States.
ex.t: 他在《瓦尔登湖》中解释了他这样做的原因：＂我去森林是因为我希望从容地生活，直面生活的基本事实。＂ 背景信息 瓦尔登湖是美国马萨诸塞州康科德的一个湖泊。
